scripts.title: ZEROFIRM TWTC: Advanced Teleport Tools
scripts.features:
ZERØFIRM TWTC
It is an advanced universal teleport tool.
It's always free and you don't need a key.

Feature :

Object Scan Teleport: Scans the map environment to locate objects (like coins or chests). Selecting an object via Pick 3D and pressing Move Obj will instantly teleport your player directly to that nearest scanned item. (Items assigned random names may not be detected perfectly, which could lead to bugs.)

Universal Auto Scan & Add: Automatically detects and adds targeted interactive items or stages across the world into your teleport list using custom prefixes or range limits.

Flexible Movement Modes: Save custom waypoints or jump points and choose how your player moves to each location via instant Teleport, Walking, or smooth Tween navigation.

Player & Target Tracking: Select other players or targets to follow, attach to, or instant-teleport 1X TP straight to their position.

Automation & Loop Controls: Execute continuous navigation or farming routines automatically using Start Loop, Loop Once, or Stop All.

Speed Boost & Auto-Respawn: Toggle character speed modifications with adjustable values and manage respawn options.

Custom Keybind Remapping: Assign fast hotkeys (using `Alt + [Key]`) for saving locations, toggling loops, boosting speed, or hiding the UI.

Data Preset Export/Import: Easily save, export, or share your custom route coordinates and settings using data codes.

scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Full Game Auto Farm , Quests, Combat, Economy +S
scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for Bee Swarm Simulator uses FishyUI and opens with RightControl, built around a master RUN switch that gates all automation except visual toggles. It automates field sweeping with serpentine routes over real flower patches, auto swinging the collector, converting at your hive, and rotating fields by laps, minutes, or conversions. Token collection supports type filtering with spawn metadata, while world automation covers sprouts, balloons, planters, puffshrooms, blooms, fireflies, leaves, meteors, and nectar pots. Combat features include mob hunting, evasion, kill aura that cycles targets in bee range, auto stinger, stump snail, and ant challenge, with the honest note that damage is server-side only. Quest rounds visit NPCs, claim and accept quests, and a hive section handles hatching eggs, royal jelly rolling, hive slots, and cell reports. Toys cover dispensers, passes, boosters, converters, and amulet generators, while economy tools handle consumables, sprinklers, buying gear by real item names, blender orders, shrine donations, sticker printer, memory match, promo codes, and amulet offers. Movement includes glide with implied noclip, teleports to fields, hive, shops, and NPCs, plus speed/jump boosts, infinite jump, noclip, and anti-AFK that reports honestly when executor APIs are unavailable. Visuals cover fullbright, no fog, and ESP for monsters, tokens, and sprouts, while performance includes max FPS presets, particle killing, graphics levels, and the game's own HideOtherBees and HideGlitchFX switches. A self-test prints what is and is not wired up, the Log tab shows recent activity, and themes plus saved configs come from FishyUI's addons.

BSS, Bee Swarm, Bee Swarm Simulator

-- Tabela para guardar os IDs das animações de andar, correr, pular e idle
local locomotionIds = {}
local ultimaVelocidade = nil

-- Função para mapear as animações do sistema de movimentação do personagem
local function carregarLocomotionIds(character)
	locomotionIds = {}
	local animateScript = character:WaitForChild("Animate", 5)
	if animateScript then
		local pastasMovimento = {"idle", "walk", "run", "jump", "fall", "climb", "swim", "strafe"}
		for _, nomePasta in ipairs(pastasMovimento) do
			local pasta = animateScript:FindFirstChild(nomePasta)
			if pasta then
				for _, obj in ipairs(pasta:GetChildren()) do
					if obj:IsA("Animation") and obj.AnimationId ~= "" then
						locomotionIds[obj.AnimationId] = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Conecta ao personagem para registrar IDs e monitorar novas animações
local function conectarCharacter(character)
	carregarLocomotionIds(character)
	
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	if not humanoid then return end
	local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
	if not animator then return end

	animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
		task.wait(0.05)
		local animId = track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId
		-- Aplica a velocidade salva caso uma nova animação de emote comece
		if not (animId and locomotionIds[animId]) and ultimaVelocidade then
			track:AdjustSpeed(ultimaVelocidade)
		end
	end)
end
